name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
label: Quest
description: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Demetria is chief advisor to the Grand Crusader. She is called the Oracle due to her 'otherworldly' senses. She has successfully assisted the Crusade in several of their victories against the Scourge.
While this ruse was successful in exposing her, if she truly does possess psychic powers, she will undoubtedly be expecting some sort of trouble. You are going to provide that 'trouble.'
Track down the Oracle and terminate her. They should be moving out of Tyr's Hand as we speak. Make me proud, worm.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They will be reeling from this blow for years! Well done, friend! You have earned not only my respect but also this reward.
